//go:build linux || darwin

package main

// Only for scripts/test-unix.sh, which lays this file over cmd/askorus-agent
// with `go build -overlay`. It is never part of the agent: release.ps1
// builds without an overlay and nothing imports scripts/testdata.
//
// It gives an update's test what the Go tests fake in one process: a
// release signed by a throwaway key and read from a folder, and the phone's
// button as a file. The update's own steps are the agent's, so systemd and
// launchd see what they see in a real update (R-177, R-178).
//
// Files in <agent folder>/test-update:
//   root.pub, release files   the release (made by `test-release`)
//   press                     the phone's button: the version it saw
//   hang                      the agent does not stop when it is asked to
//   crash-<version>           that version ends just after it came up

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/heeo-dev/askorus/agent/internal/api"
	"github.com/heeo-dev/askorus/agent/internal/config"
	"github.com/heeo-dev/askorus/agent/internal/devices"
	"github.com/heeo-dev/askorus/agent/internal/update"
)

type testReleaseFiles struct{ dir string }

func (f testReleaseFiles) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	res := &http.Response{Request: r, Header: http.Header{}, Proto: "HTTP/1.1", ProtoMajor: 1, ProtoMinor: 1}
	file, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(f.dir, path.Base(r.URL.Path)))
	if err != nil {
		res.StatusCode, res.Status, res.Body = 404, "404 Not Found", http.NoBody
		return res, nil
	}
	res.StatusCode, res.Status, res.Body = 200, "200 OK", file
	return res, nil
}

type testWork struct{}

func (testWork) Busy() api.UpdateBusy           { return api.UpdateBusy{} }
func (testWork) Hold(bool)                      {}
func (testWork) WaitIdle(context.Context) error { return nil }

// makeTestRelease: test-release <folder> <version> <program>.
func makeTestRelease(dir, v, program string) error {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(program)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	root, rootSec, err := update.NewKey()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pub, sec, err := update.NewKey()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sum := sha256.Sum256(b)
	name := update.ProgramName(runtime.GOOS, runtime.GOARCH)
	key, err := json.Marshal(update.KeyCert{Kind: update.KindKey, Key: pub.Base64(), Seq: 1, Issued: now})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rel, err := json.Marshal(update.Manifest{Kind: update.KindRelease, Product: update.Product, Version: v,
		Published: now.Add(-time.Hour), Expires: now.Add(24 * time.Hour),
		Programs: []update.Program{{OS: runtime.GOOS, Arch: runtime.GOARCH, Name: name, Size: int64(len(b)), SHA256: hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])}}})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	keySig, err := update.Sign(rootSec, key, update.KeyTrusted(1))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	relSig, err := update.Sign(sec, rel, update.ReleaseTrusted(v))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for n, d := range map[string][]byte{name: b, "root.pub": []byte(root.Base64()), update.KeyFile: key,
		update.KeySigFile: keySig, update.ReleaseFile: rel, update.ReleaseSigFile: relSig} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, n), d, 0o700); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func init() {
	if len(os.Args) == 5 && os.Args[1] == "test-release" {
		if err := makeTestRelease(os.Args[2], os.Args[3], os.Args[4]); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	dir := os.Getenv("ASKORUS_AGENT_DIR")
	if dir == "" || os.Getenv(noNodeEnv) != "1" {
		return // not inside the test
	}
	files := filepath.Join(dir, "test-update")
	updateSource = func() update.Source {
		s := update.NewSource(version)
		s.Transport = testReleaseFiles{files}
		return s
	}
	updateRoots = func() ([]update.PublicKey, error) {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(files, "root.pub"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		k, err := update.ParsePublicKey(string(b))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return []update.PublicKey{k}, nil
	}
	// The install place, <home>/.local/bin: a service has the real home.
	updateHome = func() (string, error) {
		exe, err := os.Executable()
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		return filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(exe))), nil
	}
	if len(os.Args) < 2 || os.Args[1] != "serve" {
		return
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(files, "crash-"+version)); err == nil {
		go func() {
			time.Sleep(2500 * time.Millisecond)
			os.Exit(5)
		}()
	}
	go pressButton(dir, files)
}

// pressButton runs the phone's updater when the press file appears.
func pressButton(dir, files string) {
	press := filepath.Join(files, "press")
	for {
		time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
		b, err := os.ReadFile(press)
		if err != nil || readPID(dir) != os.Getpid() {
			continue
		}
		os.Remove(press)
		cfg, err := config.Load(dir)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "test update:", err)
			continue
		}
		store, err := devices.Open(dir)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "test update:", err)
			continue
		}
		_, d, err := store.Add(fmt.Sprint("test phone ", time.Now().UnixNano()))
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "test update:", err)
			continue
		}
		u := newPhoneUpdater(dir, store, func() {
			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(files, "hang")); err == nil {
				return // asked to stop, and it does not
			}
			_ = signalStop(cfg.Port)
		})
		if err := u.Start(d.ID, strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), testWork{}); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "test update:", err)
		}
	}
}
